Against the retained baseline (exec cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef, 0/0 weights) all three physical metrics improve, also joint_acceptance_gained. This is a joint improvement, evidence of the structural effect under the fixed recipe; it is not a tradeoff.

(2) Adaptation. On the fixed structure, holding 0.05 (exec 91c3ba1b01d6499fb26df8f95409401b) passes joint with error 0.002730 m, speed 0.012750 m/s, terminal 0.002698 m; measured against its own 0/0.05 structure baseline it is a small tradeoff (error -6.79e-6 m and terminal -7.18e-6 m improve; speed +1.46e-5 m/s and mean update time +0.175 s worsen). Holding 0.10 (exec 110dc2c9c1d642dcb018664a65c62c30) loses joint acceptance (holding_speed_passed=false, speed 0.022129 m/s) and is joint_acceptance_lost versus that baseline. The adaptation conjunction therefore holds at 0.05 and fails at 0.10, so the hypothesis is weakened.

(3) Selection. Both passing configurations are fully evaluated. I select the adaptation 0.05/0.05 (batch-ebbeadbdaca10732-0) over pre-adaptation 0/0.05 (batch-e4843b561ebaea27-0): marginally smaller holding (0.002730 vs 0.002737 m) and terminal (0.002698 vs 0.002705 m) errors, at the cost of slightly higher holding speed (0.012750 vs 0.012736 m/s) and update time (8.518 vs 8.343 s) - a permitted tradeoff.
